environment: Node executes the production streaming backup parser; node:zlib and JSON.parse provide independent byte/structure fixtures

cases.name: Long project text, prototype-named properties, numeric values, escape sequences and spooled artifact spelling match independent JSON decoding
Escaped characters and Unicode remain exact across both chunk boundaries
Malformed escapes, raw controls, missing separators, mismatched containers, trailing values and non-ASCII artifact encodings are rejected
Plain retained strings are scanned in bounded spans rather than one JavaScript iteration per character
Targeted slow-scanning and mismatched-container validation faults are detected by the same cost and rejection oracles
